ops.body:
Implement a loyalty points system: earn 1 point per dollar spent; show points on the account dashboard; 100 points = a 5 dollar checkout discount; add a loyalty_points column; add GET /api/account/points and POST /api/cart/redeem-points; update the checkout flow; add tests for the earn and redeem flows.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] points accrue on completed orders
- [ ] points are redeemable at checkout
- [ ] earn and redeem paths are tested
